summary: Phase P2A (Product Versioning & Clone) — 51/51 pytest GREEN (added new TestP2AClone with 12 tests; previous 39 still pass). Frontend e2e via Playwright: all 5 review items GREEN. Suggest-version returns V2 prefill for Admin, increments to V3 after V2 exists, returns 403 for QC/Production. Clone endpoint copies sub-collections with regenerated unique ids, sets parent_sku/source_sku/version_group, writes 1 revision on new product ('Clone produk', diubah_oleh=Arif, catatan_approval='Clone dari RFL-AOD-H11-V1'). hold_old=true → source status='Hold' + Hold revision with 'versi baru: <new_sku>'. Selective copy honoured (only opted-in collections populated). Duplicate SKU → 400 with 'sudah dipakai'. Non-existent source → 404. Frontend: CloneProductDialog opens from Admin-only 'Buat Versi Baru' button (data-testid=clone-product-btn). Prefill correct (sku=RFL-AOD-H11-V2, versi=V2, nama matches source). All clone-opt-* checkboxes default checked, clone-hold-old default unchecked. Editing SKU to RFL-STD-H11-V1, name, unchecking copy_common_mistakes → submit → toast success → navigates to /products/RFL-STD-H11-V1; page shows product-parent-link pointing to RFL-AOD-H11-V1 and 'VERSION GROUP: RFL-AOD-H11-V1' card. Products list shows Original + '2 versi' on V1 row, Clone + Latest + '2 versi' on STD-V1 row. SKU collision UI: typing existing SKU into dialog and submitting shows 'sudah dipakai' toast and dialog remains open. Role gating verified — REDI (Production) and LENI (QC) have ZERO clone-product-btn elements on /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V1. Cleanup completed (deleted V2/V3/STD-V1 + cascade subcollections + reset V1.version_group/status='Released').
critical_code_review_comments: _suggest_next_sku regex /^(.+?)V(\d+)$/ correctly matches greedy-min so 'RFL-AOD-H11-V1' → prefix='RFL-AOD-H11-' + n=2. Fallback (no V<n> suffix) appends '-V2' as documented.
Clone endpoint regenerates id on every cloned sub-doc (recipe, bundles, WI, pin-map, qc-template, common-mistakes) — verified uniqueness in test_cloned_subresources_persisted.
version_group default = source['sku'] if source has no version_group; source is auto-patched to share the same group. Good.
qc_template clone copies the *single* template document (correctly, since model is one-per-sku) and reports copied['qc_template'] = len(items). Verified 10.

Selective copy: keys in 'copied' dict are only present for sections that were actually requested AND had rows (e.g., copy_common_mistakes=False → 'common_mistakes' absent). Frontend should treat missing keys as 0 — current Products page doesn't read this dict so no issue.
Minor: clone payload validation — backend does not enforce SKU format (e.g., must match /[A-Z0-9-]+/). Currently any string accepted. Low priority (Admin-only).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 5 P2A frontend review items
